class.name: LibraryAssets
class.brief_description: Asset explorer for the Zyris Library.
class.description: [LibraryAssets] is responsible for displaying project-wide [Resource] files in a thumbnail grid. It focuses on search, filtering, and dynamic organization by folders or types.

method.name: scan_project
method.description: Performs a recursive scan for resource files ([code].tres[/code], [code].res[/code]) and updates the internal list, respecting the selected grouping and sorting modes.

constants.constant: Groups resources by the directory they are saved in.
Groups resources by their class type.
